notes: fetch_osm.py includes only built highway classes, so every OSM way retagged highway=construction disappears from the game. OSM editors in Rishon retag live roads as 'construction' during Brown Line / Green Line works (Sept-Oct 2026). The add_ways 'restore' items (confidence high) put those existing roads back; a generic fix is to map highway=construction + construction=<class> to that class at bake time when the way had that class in a previous version.

Green Line light rail (dark green branch) works in the bbox: Moshe Dayan / Lishansky / Avnei Hoshen / Sakharov; Avraham Bar x Yeladei Tehran junction gets a ~10-week works layout from 2026-10-22 (left turns banned). Opening is 2028+ (he.wikipedia), so no running LRT should be drawn.

Brown Line Metronit BRT works: Rothschild (from 2025-11-11), Sderot Yitzhak Rabin / Levi Eshkol / HaHistadrut (from 2026-06-28), Levi Eshkol Moshe Dayan..HaYayin (from 2026-10-13, ~7 months), Derech Haim Herzog (from 2026-01-07, ~10 months). Project runs to 2028.

Building footprints in the whole bbox match Esri imagery of 2025-02-26 (16 overlay tiles checked); no unmapped towers found inside the bbox. Anything built after Feb 2025 cannot be verified with free imagery.
Roundabouts in OSM bbox: 151 ways, 99 of them edited 2023-2026; no other roundabout has evidence of conversion.
Neve Hadarim (31.959, 34.817) is outside the game bbox (east edge 34.81).

2026-10-17 (round 6): the replace_junction for Kikar Yitzhak Rabin (way 164818922, by the College of Management) is reverted: the founder says Rabin Square is still a roundabout, and OSM agrees. The roundabout he remembered being replaced is HaTkuma's in Kiryat HaLeom (way 267041409, 31.9696, 34.7792): OSM deleted it on 2021-11-27, changeset 114290755 by Sanniu, comment 'replacing roundabout with a controlled interchange' (Maxar imagery). OSM already maps it as a junction, so no correction is needed; the bake now reads traffic_signals nodes (data/rishon.signals.raw.json).

for: Brown Line BRT (Metronit) route runs Sderot Yitzhak Rabin -> Levi Eshkol, i.e. turns exactly through this roundabout (he.wikipedia rev 2026-07-05).

Brown Line works on Levi Eshkol / Sderot Yitzhak Rabin started 2026-06-28 (be106.net/231/148590 snippet); works on Levi Eshkol continue from 2026-10-13 for ~7 months (be106.net/231/161586 snippet). BRT corridors in Israel are normally signal-controlled, so a 2026 conversion (temporary or final) is plausible.
against_or_unknown: OSM still junction=roundabout; ring geometry last changed 2023-05-04 (HopOn, cs 135692757), last edit 2023-10-14; an active local mapper (Sanniu) edited the adjacent Israel Galili mouth on 2026-09-28 and did not touch the ring.
Esri imagery captured 2025-02-26 shows the roundabout intact (~90 m across, landscaped island).
Newest Mapillary images at the junction are from 2021-02-14 / 2021-02-24; no 2024-2026 street imagery here.
No municipal or news item found that names a roundabout-to-signals conversion at Kikar Rabin; be106 / mynet pages are behind a bot check and were not read.

reverted_replace_junction.suggested_geometry: Replace the ring with a 4-arm signalised crossroads: Sderot Yitzhak Rabin straight W-E, Motta Gur from SW meeting Levi Eshkol to NE, signals node at the centre point. Keep lanes=2+ per direction (secondary).
